fields.value: Fix the launch, provider-refusal and fetch defects found in the 0.4.1 live smoke

Found by the live smoke of main 6abc647 on 2026-11-16 (RunPod CPU + R2), before 0.4.1. Jack Heart approved fixing them before the release: "ho for it" \[go for it\]. Full report with commands, ids and logs: /Users/jack/src/etude.exp-66-name-the-job/scratch/live-smoke-20261116.md (copy it into this Task's scratch at kickoff; per-step logs under /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jack-src-etude-exp-66-name-the-job/663602e7-d5d3-46fd-898c-140f5798f021/scratchpad/smoke-main/scratch/).

Fix, with a test for each, in one PR on main:

1. `launch` right after `wait` fails with "at its machine limit" on the taught `launch; wait; launch` sequence with `--max 1` (reproduced three times): the finished machine stays `available` and counts against the limit until a second `wait`. Proposed: reconcile ended sessions before the capacity check (or `wait` confirms deletion before returning). Pick the one that leaves one owner for that fact.
2. A RunPod 4xx reply to creating a pod (capacity: "no longer any instances available") is treated as "create reply unknown": the machine sticks at `starting`, the run is blocked with `reconciling existing request` until `etude terminate`, and the provider's reason is discarded; `availability` said `rentable now` seconds before. Proposed: a 4xx reply to POST pods is a refusal (`Refused`) carrying a bounded excerpt of the body; the run stays queued with that reason.
3. `etude fetch` cannot retrieve a typed training job's outputs: a file in `run.out` gives `recorded no output`; `etude-result.json` is recorded as an output but never uploaded (404 traceback on fetch); files written to `ETUDE_OUTPUT_DIR` do work. Proposed: do not record the result file as an output, make run.out members fetchable or say plainly where outputs live, and list the available names in the error.
   Not in scope: a report from a bucket needing the network for its listing (document as a limit in docs/limits.md).

Then live-verify: repeat the smoke's steps 2 and 5 on one RunPod CPU on-demand, and run step 6 (one short GPU eval through the shared agent process) when RunPod has GPU capacity. Spend at most $0.75 total; each rental deadline at most 30 minutes; delete every machine and confirm it is absent at the provider. Credentials and storage: as in the smoke report (Doppler etude/prd RUNPOD_API_KEY; R2 from Doppler manabot/prd under launch/etude-r2-smoke-\* only; isolated ETUDE_HOME). Leave other pods in the account alone. No release, no merge.
